landing.headline: AI-Powered Transparency and Infrastructure Intelligence
landing.description: AEGIS helps public agencies, communities, and oversight teams monitor infrastructure projects, benchmark costs, verify field reports, and surface risk signals with clarity.
landing.featuresDescription: A modular platform designed for transparent project monitoring, supplier visibility, and AI-assisted accountability.
landing.howDescription: From raw project data to citizen-ready intelligence in a secure review flow.
landing.aboutTitle: Transparency infrastructure for the next generation of public works
landing.aboutDescription: AEGIS exists to make infrastructure spending easier to understand, verify, and improve. The platform converts project records, citizen evidence, and market benchmarks into decision-ready insights for agencies and communities.
landing.testimonialsTitle: Designed for teams that need trust at scale
landing.contactDescription: Deploy AEGIS for project monitoring, price benchmarking, and public transparency workflows.

monitoring.title: Infrastructure Monitoring
monitoring.description: Track contract values, schedule slippage, locations, and project status in a unified command center.

benchmarking.title: Market Price Benchmarking
benchmarking.description: Compare declared material costs against local baselines to identify pricing outliers early.

supplier.title: Supplier Intelligence
supplier.description: Map contractors, materials, and procurement signals across active public works packages.

geo.title: Geo-tagged Verification
geo.description: Prepare field reports for precise location-aware validation during on-site inspections.

aiRisk.title: AI Risk Detection
aiRisk.description: Convert cost, progress, and citizen signals into clear risk explanations for reviewers.

transparency.title: Transparency Dashboard
transparency.description: Give stakeholders a clean, accessible view of public infrastructure performance.

analytics.title: Analytics & Reporting
analytics.description: Generate executive-ready summaries for agencies, NGOs, and presentation teams.

tracking.title: Project Tracking
tracking.description: Follow each project from budget approval through implementation and verification.

testimonials.oneQuote: AEGIS makes complex project records understandable without losing the audit trail.
testimonials.twoQuote: The risk cards are exactly the kind of field-first view our reviewers need.

dashboard.title: Infrastructure intelligence dashboard
dashboard.description: Monitor DPWH project risk, budget deviation, material variance, and citizen verification signals from one secure console.
dashboard.searchPlaceholder: Contract ID, barangay, contractor, road section
dashboard.loadedFrom: Loaded from live DPWH Watchdog API

upload.title: Upload a field verification report
upload.description: Capture site evidence, attach it to a nearby project, and add quick notes for review.
upload.notesPlaceholder: Describe progress, delays, site condition, materials, workers, safety, or public access issues.
upload.successMessage: Report captured for prototype review. Phase 2 will add geolocation and offline queueing.

suppliers.title: Supplier and material intelligence
suppliers.description: Compare declared unit costs against local baselines for cement, steel, pavement, drainage, and earthworks items.
